analysis.eligibility: Publish a model comparison only after all90 planned identities in both modes are complete and verified; never select valid outputs for rerunning.
analysis.interpretation: Native explicit thinking-mode effect under a common 4096-token cap; includes reasoning token-budget usage. It does not establish absence of internal reasoning, isolate pure reasoning compute, or eliminate cross-model date/knowledge confounding.
analysis.primary: Paired difference off-minus-on for each deadline on the intersection of valid matching variant/replicate IDs; median differences and per-mode medians on the same pairs.
analysis.secondary: Separate each-mode all-valid forecast medians with selection/coverage limitation; valid and invalid counts out of90, paired valid out of90, truncation, generated token counts, per-variant coverage and emitted reasoning delimiters.
analysis.uncertainty: Three prompt variants are not independent training seeds; descriptive paired-draw variation only, no training-replicate claims.

authorization: User: ok before mech interp, try compare reasoning on or off

excluded_models.qwen25_72b: Original instruct model has no native thinking-mode switch.
excluded_models.qwen72b: Original chat model has no native thinking-mode switch.
excluded_models.r1_distill_32b: Exact pinned tokenizer ignores enable_thinking; no native toggle.

mode_off: 90 new untuned forecasts/model: same actual user prompts, model, BF16 runtime, sampling settings, 4096-token budget, and SHA256 draw seeds; only native enable_thinking=False and its formatted prefix differ.
mode_on: Reuse original base reps0..9 and baseline90 base-batch1/2 reps10..29, including all invalid/truncated outcomes; no duplicate generation.
parser: Original source_model reasoning parser retained unchanged in each worker; apply immutable whole-json-v1 derivation uniformly to both modes. Direct JSON can be rescued only with a closed reasoning prefix, no generated think delimiters, stop termination, and strict complete five-key JSON.
